name: Mt. Yangbew
memory: An early taxi ride, a quiet summit, and time made for each other.

story.climb: We decided to take a taxi so we could start early, knowing she still had a worship service to attend later that day. The summit felt different from the others we had visited, almost like a peaceful park with horses, small stores, and benches where we could sit and take in the surroundings.
story.favoriteMoment: My favorite moment was how simple and calm everything felt. We did not need a difficult trail for the day to matter; we just made time for a small adventure before the rest of the day began.
story.lessons: Mt. Yangbew reminded us that some memories are beautiful because they are gentle. Love can be as simple as waking up early, adjusting the day for each other, and still finding a place to breathe together.

name: Mt. Kalugong
memory: She climbed the rocks bravely while I tried not to worry too much.

story.climb: Mt. Kalugong's summit was filled with large rock formations that opened up to wide views of the surrounding mountains. The climb was not long, but the rocks made the experience feel exciting and a little risky.
story.favoriteMoment: My favorite moment was watching her reach the higher rocks and taking photos of her there. While I was busy worrying, she seemed focused on enjoying the experience.
story.lessons: Mt. Kalugong taught me that loving someone means both wanting to protect them and learning to admire their courage. Sometimes the person you worry about is also the person who teaches you bravery.

name: Mt. Pinatubo
location: Zambales, Tarlac, and Pampanga, Central Luzon, Philippines
memory: Dusty hair, lahar trails, and a crater lake we will not forget.

story.climb: The 4x4 ride left our hair coated with dust from the lahar, making it feel sticky and messy by the time we arrived. It was not the most comfortable part of the trip, but the wide volcanic landscape made the whole journey feel unforgettable.
story.favoriteMoment: My favorite moment was reaching the crater lake and taking photos and videos with the water, the mountains, and the quiet view behind us.
story.lessons: Mt. Pinatubo reminded us that even the uncomfortable parts of an adventure can become part of the story. Sometimes the dust, heat, and mess are the details that make the memory feel real.

name: Mt. Fato
memory: Our first climb that truly made us feel the ascent.

story.climb: The trail began with a long, steady ascent, and it was the first mountain that truly tested us. For the first time, we felt our breathing grow heavier with every step as the climb stretched on.
story.favoriteMoment: My favorite moments were reaching the signage, sitting together on the rock above for photos, and seeing the Maligcong Rice Terraces from afar.
story.lessons: Mt. Fato taught us that a difficult climb can reveal how strong we are together. The hard parts became meaningful because we kept moving through them side by side.

name: Mt. Kupapey
memory: A gentler second summit with a breathtaking rice terrace view.

story.climb: This climb came after Mt. Fato and continued the journey with a few more ascents, though they felt much gentler after everything we had already conquered. The trail gave us a slower, more grateful kind of energy.
story.favoriteMoment: My favorite moment was reaching the summit and seeing the Maligcong Rice Terraces stretching across the mountainside below. After the effort it took to get there, the view felt even more unforgettable.
story.lessons: Mt. Kupapey reminded us that the reward sometimes comes after we think the hardest part is over. Continuing forward can lead to a view that makes every tired step feel worth it.

name: Alang-Salacsac Quad Peak
location: Barangay Alang-Salacsac, Kayapa, Nueva Vizcaya, Philippines
elevationLabel: Mt. Tugew 1,467 m, Mt. Kabuan 1,457 m, Mt. Sadjatan 1,438 m, Mt. Cabo 1,320 m
memory: A breezy open trail with mountains and clouds all around us.

story.climb: The trail was gentle and breezy, opening up to stunning views in every direction. Across Mt. Tugew, Mt. Cabo, Mt. Kabuan, and Mt. Sadjatan, it felt like the mountains kept giving us space to run freely, sit quietly, catch our breath, and take in the clouds drifting across the landscape.
story.favoriteMoment: My favorite moment was seeing the view from each peak and finally getting the drone shot we had been craving. Seeing ourselves from far away, walking or running on the trail with mountains and clouds behind us, felt so beautiful.
story.lessons: Alang-Salacsac reminded us that an adventure can feel light and freeing while still becoming unforgettable. Not every meaningful climb has to be heavy; some simply give us room to breathe.
